items.description: Assumption 1 states unified-ledger is at 100% for all cohorts. The rollout config it cites shows percentage 5 and cohort internal-only, so the legacy branch still serves nearly all traffic and step 1 would delete a live path.

Step 2 calls the legacy-ledger-read flag now-unused. src/ledger.ts:5 gates the legacy read on that flag and the cited config has it enabled at percentage 100, so with unified at 5% it is the flag routing nearly every read today. Dropping the entry switches the live path off rather than deleting dead config.
